description_paragraphs: i created kromatika for those few seconds of satisfaction when a row of mixed-up color tiles clicks together as a lovely gradient.

at the beginning of each puzzle, you start with a small number of fixed tiles and several that are waiting outside their gaps. drag these loose tiles into the empty spaces until each line contains an uninterrupted gradient. the first few levels are small and relatively simple. as you progress through the game, however, the lines begin to intersect and fork off in different directions; some tile placements can settle two gradients at the same time.

there are {campaign_level_count} puzzles in the campaign, and i designed every one by hand. there are plenty of other ways to keep playing. {feature_daily}. {feature_zen}. {feature_challenge}. {feature_creator}.

the {daily_name}, {gallery_name}, and first {free_campaign_chapter_count} campaign chapters are free. the {purchase_name} is a single purchase with no recurring subscription. it opens the rest of the campaign, infinite {zen_name}, {challenge_name} runs, and the puzzle {creator_name}.

notes_paragraphs: kromatika has no app-specific account or sign-in. game center is optional and uses the reviewer’s device account.
